capabilities: draw chemical structures and insert them into notes
render SMILES code blocks as SVG images
embed and edit .mol files from the vault
auto-wrap pasted SMILES strings in code blocks
extras: The manifest warns that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Some database/ELN features from a previous version are announced for a future release.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw chemical structures or render chemical formats like SMILES and MOL inside notes, especially on mobile.

relations.evidence: Powered by the excellent OpenChemLib library (the same engine behind DataWarrior).

summary: Chemical structure editor that draws molecules and renders SMILES and MOL data as SVG images, working offline on desktop and mobile.
